item.title: 科研论文每日速递 | 2026-09-18 | 9 篇
item.description:
本期收录 9 篇论文。

  1. SAF-CropNet: Spatially adaptive fusion of SAR and optical imagery for semantic segmentation in operational cropland mapping across regions — SAF-CropNet：SAR与光学影像空间自适应融合用于跨区域业务化农田制图语义分割 (85/100)
  2. Structure-preserving feature disentanglement with an adaptive transformer for unsupervised cross-domain object detection in heterogeneous SAR imagery — 结构保持特征解耦与自适应Transformer用于异构SAR影像无监督跨域目标检测 (82/100)
  3. PDA++: Field-Aligned Planning and Scene-Adaptive Insertion in Remote Sensing — PDA++：遥感中的场对齐规划与场景自适应插入 (78/100)
  4. Deep Evidential Regression for Sparse Forest Height Estimation from Multimodal Satellite Imagery — 基于多模态卫星影像的稀疏森林高度估计深度证据回归 (74/100)
  5. Toward scalable organ-level 3D plant segmentation: A systematic and quantitative review through the lens of the data-algorithm-computing triangle — 面向可扩展器官级三维植物分割：基于数据-算法-计算三角的系统定量综述 (70/100)
  6. Tabular Deep Learning vs Classical Machine Learning for Urban Land Cover Classification — 表格深度学习与经典机器学习在城市土地覆盖分类中的对比 (62/100)
  7. Decoder-Agnostic Token Merging for Vision Transformers: A Systematic Study of G2TM — 面向视觉Transformer的解码器无关Token合并：G2TM的系统研究 (55/100)
  8. UniFusion: Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction via Unified Spatio-temporal Depth Alignment — UniFusion：通过统一时空深度对齐实现稀疏视图4D重建 (50/100)
  9. Hierarchical Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Coherent Emergency Department Forecasting — 用于连贯急诊科预测的分层时空Transformer (45/100)
